translated_text: My dear, July 17, 2020. I received your letter of July 14. I have already answered almost everything you asked in my last letters. Now I am waiting for permission to come and get you. I hope you will come without any problems. I will wait here until the class is demobilized; we'll count the end of the month. Naturally, Mama will stay with us. But I don't want to go to Paris. Maybe in 3-4 months. I think we can stay here even if Paris is free; we have a reason. For the moment, I have work in Agde, and if it stops because of winter, I have the same intention as you. We will manage on our own. You have a complete workshop. Until now, I haven't needed you, Z., because I found something right away. But perhaps later. – And that's fine, if possible I'd like to telegraph you before I leave. But it's not certain, my dear. Only the question of gasoline worries me; I think you now need a safe-conduct even to travel by car. In any case, look for information now; it's terrible traveling by train. I'm eagerly awaiting my permission; you know how much I long for it. Eigenthal Agde Hérault & fon 17. We FM P Madame 18 GDE E.
